channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Edwina Grima is PN’s top choice for chief justice
item.description: PN's preferred candidate is Edwina Grima but government has not given feedback on the choice

item.title: Chamber of Commerce condemns eligibility of businesses with illegalities for Storm Harry fund
item.description: Treating compliant and non-compliant businesses on the same basis, creates an uneven playing field and risks encouraging further disregard for planning and environmental regulations, the Chamber of Commerce argues

item.title: Woman who posed as a bank to scam around 200 people out of €1 million denied bail
item.description: Woman, 25, is remanded in custody after pleading not guilty to defrauding around 200 people by posing as a bank, with the court hearing how victims suffered losses amounting to €1 million

item.title: NGOs call on public to object to artificial lighting in Dwejra
item.description: The NGOs explained that allowing artificial light in Dwejra would disorient seabirds and undermine the very qualities that justified Dwejra’s protection in the first place

item.title: Spain plans to ban social media for children under 16
item.description: Social media platforms to require age verification before use in Spain, in a push to safeguard youths

item.title: President urges government, Opposition to reach agreement on chief justice
item.description: Justice Minister Jonathan Attard says a meeting took place with the president but did not divulge further details

item.title: Construction worker injured in Żurrieq roof collapse, inquiry launched
item.description: Authorities are investigating an injury sustained by a worker after a ceiling collapsed during demolition works in Żurrieq on Wednesday

item.title: Emanuel Delias victory in defamation case against lecturer Simon Mercieca confirmed on appeal
item.description: Appeals Court confirms libel judgment in case instituted by activist Emanuel Delia against lecturer Simon Mercieca over 2023 blogposts • Mercieca ordered to pay €1,300

item.title: No two-thirds support for Judge Scerri Herrera’s nomination for chief justice
item.description: Government’s nomination for chief justice does not pass after it fails to achieve a two-thirds parliamentary majority in Wednesday parliamentary vote • Robert Abela claims Alex Borg proposed Judge Consuelo Scerri Herrera for chief justice

item.title: Malta’s free childcare scheme boosts employment for single mothers and larger families
item.description: Free childcare has helped single mothers and families with multiple children enter the workforce while raising female participation and reducing welfare dependence
